name_zh: 李登辉/蔡英文/民主先驱：民主转型共识与制度化和平移权
name_en: Lee Teng-hui/Tsai Ing-wen/Democratic Pioneers: Democratic Transition Consensus & Institutionalized Peaceful Transfer
description_zh: 李登辉 (1923-2020) "台湾民主之父"，主导 1991-1996 系列宪法修正、废除《动员戡乱条款》、首次总统直选 (1996)；蔡英文 (1956-) 首位女性总统，推动《促进转型正义条例》、原住民历史正义、性别平权、国防自主。跨蓝绿两代领袖共同完成：威权体制→程序民主→实质民主→转型正义。核心机制：宪法渐进修正(不废不立)→选举制度重构(单一选区两票制)→政党轮替常态化(2000/2008/2016)→历史清算程序化(促转会)。体现 M164 民主转型共识——以"程序正义替代实质对抗"，在深度分裂社会中建立跨党派共识基线。
description_en: Lee Teng-hui (1923-2020) "Father of Taiwan Democracy" led 1991-96 constitutional amendments, abolished Temporary Provisions, first direct presidential election (1996); Tsai Ing-wen (1956-) first female president, advanced Transitional Justice Act, indigenous historical justice, gender equality, defense autonomy. Across Blue/Green two generations: authoritarian regime → procedural democracy → substantive democracy → transitional justice. Core mechanism: incremental constitutional amendment (neither abolish nor enact) → electoral system restructuring (single-member district two-vote) → party rotation normalization (2000/2008/2016) → historical reckoning proceduralization (Transitional Justice Commission). Exemplifies M164 Democratic Transition Consensus—"procedural justice replaces substantive confrontation", establishing cross-party consensus baseline in deeply divided society.
reason_zh: 台湾民主转型非革命突变，而是"宪法渐进主义+选举工程+跨党派共识"三位一体：李登辉在国民党内部推动改革，蔡英文在民进党执政下深化转型正义。M164 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉)、M162 多元文化联邦(加拿大)，核心在于"程序正义替代实质对抗"的和平转型工程。
reason_en: Taiwan's democratic transition not revolutionary rupture but trinity of "constitutional gradualism + electoral engineering + cross-party consensus": Lee pushed reform from within KMT, Tsai deepened transitional justice under DPP. M164 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultation) and M162 Multicultural Federation (Canada), core: "procedural justice replaces substantive confrontation" peaceful transition engineering.
steps_zh: 宪法渐进修正路径：1991-2005 七次增修条文，废除动员戡乱/省虚级化/冻结省议会
选举制度重构工程：1994 省长/市长直选→1996 总统直选→2005 单一选区两票制→2020 同票制
政党轮替常态化锚定：2000 陈水扁/2008 马英九/2016 蔡英文/2024 赖清德，四次和平轮替
转型正义程序化：2018 促转会成立→档案解密/不当判决撤销/威权象征移除/原住民道歉
跨海峡互动框架：李登辉"两国论"→蔡英文"九二共识不接受/现状维持"，务实避战
steps_en: Constitutional gradual amendment path: 1991-2005 seven amendment rounds, abolished Temporary Provisions/provincial streamlining/frozen provincial assembly
Electoral system restructuring engineering: 1994 governor/mayor direct election -> 1996 presidential direct election -> 2005 single-member district two-vote -> 2020 same-vote system
Party rotation normalization anchoring: 2000 Chen/2008 Ma/2016 Tsai/2024 Lai, four peaceful rotations
Transitional justice proceduralization: 2018 Transitional Justice Commission -> archives declassification/wrongful convictions overturned/authoritarian symbols removed/indigenous apology
Cross-strait interaction framework: Lee "two states theory" -> Tsai "reject 1992 Consensus/maintain status quo", pragmatic conflict avoidance
expected_zh: 深度分裂社会以"程序正义+选举工程+历史清算"三位一体实现和平民主化，避免革命暴力/内战/政权报复，为后发民主化提供"台湾模式"范式。
expected_en: Deeply divided society achieves peaceful democratization via trinity of "procedural justice + electoral engineering + historical reckoning", avoiding revolutionary violence/civil war/regime retaliation, providing "Taiwan model" paradigm for late democratization.
case_zh: 1996 首次总统直选→2000 首次政党轮替→2018 促转会成立→2024 第四次轮替，28 年零政变/零内战/零政治清洗，民主指数长期亚洲第一。
case_en: 1996 first direct presidential election -> 2000 first party rotation -> 2018 Transitional Justice Commission -> 2024 fourth rotation, 28 years zero coups/zero civil war/zero political purges, democracy index consistently Asia #1.
cross_cultural_impact: Taiwan model for peaceful democratization; Hong Kong/Thailand/Myanmar reference; constitutional gradualism theory
diaspora_influence: Taiwanese-American advocacy for Taiwan Relations Act; global democracy network
indigenous_knowledge_system: 16 indigenous peoples recognized; Tsai 2016 formal apology; Austronesian cultural revival
